title: In vitro and in vivo characterization of porcine acellular dermal matrix for gingival augmentation procedures
authors: Pabst AM, Happe A, Callaway A, Ziebart T, Stratul SI, Ackermann M, Konerding MA, Willershausen B, Kasaj A. J Periodontal Res. 2014 Jun;49(3):371-81. doi: 10.1111/jre.12115.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Overall, the results suggest that PADM is a promising substitute for autogenous soft tissue grafts in periodontal surgery” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
